verdict.rationale: Expensify does document an API (Integration Server) with OAuth2/credential-based auth for building integrations, showing openness in principle, but the evidence pack gives no indication of feature parity — no documented API endpoints for actions like approvals, invoicing, travel booking, or workspace configuration that mirror UI capabilities. missing for 10: comprehensive API endpoint documentation, evidence of parity for approvals/invoicing/travel/config actions, independent confirmation that AI-native workflows can fully replace UI usage via API.
